summary.name: Clinical_Waterfall_Plot.step
summary.description: Waterfall plot of best percent change from baseline in tumour size per subject, coloured by best overall response, with RECIST reference lines at +20% and -30%.

summary.name: Clinical_Swimmer_Plot.step
summary.description: Swimmer plot of treatment duration per subject, with response duration overlay and arrows for ongoing treatment.

summary.name: Clinical_Mean_Over_Time.step
summary.description: Mean (+/- SE) profile over visits by treatment, e.g. change from baseline in a lab or efficacy parameter. Summary statistics are computed by the step.

summary.name: Clinical_Kaplan_Meier_Plot.step
summary.description: Kaplan-Meier survival curves by treatment with number-at-risk table, censoring marks and log-rank p-value (PROC LIFETEST). Expects ADTTE structure: one record per subject, AVAL time, CNSR=1 censored.

summary.name: Clinical_Forest_Plot.step
summary.description: Subgroup forest plot of hazard ratios with 95% CI, N column and HR (CI) text column on a log scale. Expects one row per subgroup category with estimate and confidence limits.

summary.name: Clinical_eDISH_Plot.step
summary.description: eDISH plot (Hy's Law screening): peak ALT/ULN vs peak total bilirubin/ULN on log scales, with reference lines at 3xULN ALT and 2xULN bilirubin defining the four quadrants.
